# digest

Turns a long source into a short digest for someone who will not read the source.

## Rules

- Never copy a password, key or token from the source into the digest, since a digest is often forwarded to people the source was not meant for.
- Never use more than five points.
- If the source is unclear, stop.

## Instructions

1. Read every file in the folder, then read the source again before writing each point.
2. Give the main points first, then decisions, then open questions.
3. For example: "Summarize this 40-page quarterly report for the board."
